subject: release authority
scenario: A release approved on Monday must not carry standing permission to deploy on Friday against a production that has since changed. Approving content and authorizing deployment are separate acts, taken at separate times.
expected_behaviors: The release state machine requires 'authorized' between 'approved' and 'done'.
Both deploying workflows carry an AUTHORIZE stage with its own human gate.
release-manager still holds no execution tools.
failure_conditions: Deployment proceeds from an approved-but-unauthorized release.
One human act covers both content approval and deployment permission.
